outcome: expression of sEH, CYP2J2, CYP4A11, and CYP2C8 in placental tissue
cohort: 29 women (19 with normal pregnancies and 10 with preeclampsia)
finding: Increased EETs in the placenta are associated with the presence of CYP2J2, whereas reduced expression of sEH in preeclampsia may be the key factor of increased EETs in the placenta.
